description: Log that you're drinking one of your bottles (posts to your followers' feed, like the app's Pour). Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

confirm_token.description: Omit on the first call to get a preview. After the user agrees, call again with identical arguments plus this token.

name: log_pour
